items.name: Ink
items.role: the brand's only "color." Headlines, body text, primary CTA fill, nav links, and every solid icon. Treats nearly-black as the brand color rather than pure blac…

items.name: Ink Deep
items.role: pressed-state for the primary CTA. Carries a faint red undertone matching the canvas's warm cast.

items.name: Cream
items.role: the brand's signature warm white. Used for every page body, every card surface, the on-primary text color, and the ASCII wordmark fill on dark.

items.name: Canvas Cream
items.role: every page body, every card.

items.name: Soft Surface
items.role: text-input default background, testimonial row fill, alternating row tint.

items.name: Surface Card
items.role: install-snippet pill, disabled button fill, slightly-elevated section row.

items.name: Surface Dark
items.role: the hero TUI mockup background and the dark CTA pill on the home page. Identical to the brand uses one near-black for both text and dark surfaces.

items.name: Surface Dark Elevated
items.role: the prompt-row inside the hero TUI mockup, one notch lighter than the dark surface itself.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: ): 1px section divider. The translucent warm tint matches the cream canvas's undertone.

items.name: Hairline Strong
items.role: tab strip's bottom rule and stronger inline divider.

items.name: Ink
items.role: headlines, body text, primary nav links, button text on light surfaces.

items.name: Charcoal
items.role: subtly softer body where pure ink is too heavy.

items.name: Body
items.role: default paragraph text and FAQ answers.

items.name: Mute
items.role: tab labels (default state), metadata, footer link text, in-list secondary annotations.

items.name: Stone
items.role: least-emphasis utility text, breadcrumb separators.

items.name: Ash
items.role: disabled text and secondary annotation in dark TUI mockup, also TUI mockup secondary color.

items.name: Accent
items.role: primary informational signal, in-product link color, TUI command highlight.

items.name: Accent Hover
items.role: pressed informational link.

items.name: Accent Active
items.role: deeply-pressed informational state.

items.name: Danger
items.role: destructive confirmation, error state.

items.name: Danger Hover
items.role: pressed destructive.

items.name: Danger Active
items.role: deeply-pressed destructive.

items.name: Warning
items.role: caution callouts.

items.name: Warning Hover
items.role: pressed caution.

items.name: Warning Active
items.role: deeply-pressed caution.

items.name: Success
items.role: positive confirmation, in-TUI success indicator.
